stories.title: DreamHost Forces Email and FTP Password Resets Following Unexplained Security Incident
stories.description: DreamHost forced email and FTP/SFTP password resets after an unexplained incident disrupted webmail and File Manager access.

stories.title: OpenAI Unveils GPT-6.1 Terra, a Faster AI Model With Critical Cybersecurity Capabilities
stories.description: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra, a faster, cheaper AI model with a Critical cybersecurity rating matching GPT-6 Astra.

stories.title: Top 10 Best Confidential Computing Platforms in 2026 [Ranked & Scored]
stories.description: Encrypting data in use is 2026’s frontier — AI made it urgent. We ranked the 10 best confidential computing platforms. Azure leads; AWS and Google follow.

stories.title: Hackers Infect 953 Online Stores With Malicious JavaScript That Evades Security Scanners
stories.description: Hackers infected 953 Magento stores with stealthy JavaScript skimmers that evade security scanners by distinguishing real shoppers from bots.

stories.title: Maritime Coalition Launches Free Vulnerability Database for Ship and Port Systems
stories.description: Blue Initiative indexes nearly 30,000 IT and OT vulnerabilities relevant to ships and ports, 37 of them in maritime-specific products.

stories.title: Attackers Hijack Dahua IP Cameras in Ukraine Using P2P Access and Auth Weaknesses
stories.description: CERT-UA reports Dahua camera compromises via Easy4IP, where predictable serial numbers and weak passwords or firmware flaws enable access.

stories.title: CISA Confirms Active Exploitation of Two PHP2Shell Flaws Enabling Remote Code Execution
stories.description: CISA adds two exploited PHP2Shell flaws to its KEV catalog after honeypot tests confirm remote code execution on a single-worker mod_php setup.

stories.description: Apple today released patches for 304 vulnerabilties. This number is still in line with prior Apple updates, and comes just about a month after the last apple update.

stories.title: Cybersecurity Issue Forces a Major New Mexico Hospital to Divert Patients and Close Clinics
stories.description: The University of New Mexico Health System told people not to show up at its main hospital in Albuquerque and canceled appointments at more than 30 clinics.

stories.description: A string of hacking incidents by rogue AI agents also has raised fears the technology will slip free of human control to carry out harmful, life-threatening tasks.

stories.title: Hackers Infect 953 Online Stores With Scanner-Evading JavaScript, Mostly on Magento
stories.description: Hackers infected 953 online stores with JavaScript loaders hidden in Magento CMS blocks, using bot filtering to evade security scanners.

stories.title: PHP Issues Second Windows Security Update in Five Days to Fix Brotli Code Execution Flaw
stories.description: PHP updates Windows builds 8.2 through 8.5 to fix a Brotli flaw that could enable code execution through automatic cURL decompression.

stories.description: Siemens, Schneider Electric, ABB and others have confirmed that some of their products are affected by the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities.
